# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (2023-03-17) · 2026-11-12 00:31
> Receiver: run /shift-start first, then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (no open task; be ready for follow-ups on any thread below)

## 0 · Read these first (required)
No project files. The repo contains only `.claude/` (skill files) and commit `d041f25 start` [verified: git status / git log]. Everything that matters is in this handover.

## 1 · Status
🟢 No code work, nothing running. The session was 11 separate chat threads, all dated **Fri 2023-03-17** (times run from 00:03 to 18:12, logged out of order). Every thread ended without a pending deliverable. The only open thread is the **Hedy Lamarr debate rebuttal**: my last answer was **cut off mid-sentence** (see §3).

## 2 · Picture
A general-purpose assistant user. Threads were: niece's birthday party plus a theme for the twins; Indian evidence/cyber-law exam questions; foster-care adoption in California; "hello"; the first US president; Métis economic-hardship resources; the film "Actress" and women in lead roles; graduation and coworker gifts; a 401k committee email; healthy breakfast/smoothie; AI in healthcare/leadership/education reading; women in politics plus a Hedy Lamarr rebuttal.
No hypotheses are in dispute. Accuracy problems in my own earlier answers are listed in §6. Fix them if the user returns to those topics.

## 3 · Next actions
1. If the user returns to the debate, **finish the Hedy Lamarr rebuttal** as a debate-ready paragraph. The user's words were: "make this part of rebuttal in debatae like that hold you is women who make a wifi and bluetooth thanks that you can search now". Their point: a woman's invention underlies the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth the opponent uses right now. Facts to use: frequency-hopping patent with George Antheil, US Patent 2,292,387 (1942), designed to stop torpedo radio guidance from being jammed. Be careful: the patent is a *precursor* to spread-spectrum, so don't say she "invented Wi-Fi". Done when the user has a punchy rebuttal paragraph.
2. Otherwise there is nothing pending. Answer follow-ups using §5 and §6b, and correct the §6 errors when they come up.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Don't | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Re-suggest a **princess party** for Olivia | User: "I'm not sure if Olivia would like it… something more unique and not so traditional" | User brings it back |
| Repeat "ESRI compliance" as if it were a real 401k concept | It is almost certainly **ERISA** (Employee Retirement Income Security Act), which governs 401k plans. Neither I nor the user caught this. The user guessed FINRA | — |
| Claim the user has FINRA experience in the Steve email | I invented that ("I do have some experience with FINRA compliance"). The user never said it | User confirms it |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said] on 2023-03-17 unless noted):
- **Niece Olivia** is turning 6 "soon" (kindergarten age). The user is planning her party and chose the **Art Studio Party** (the Outer Space Expedition was the runner-up). Plan: art stations (paint, markers, glue, paper) and a display of the kids' artwork.
- **Twins Jackson & Julia** are the children of the user's **brother and sister-in-law Rachel**. They were **born February 12** (said 2023-03-17, so presumably 2023, about 5 weeks old then). The user is "busy" helping and the twins are "keeping me on my toes". The parents are considering a gender-neutral theme for the twins' **first birthday** (Woodland Wonderland or Little Explorer were liked). Note: if they were born Feb 2023, the first birthday is Feb 12, 2024, not imminent. Earlier I wrongly treated it as "coming up".
- The user is **in California** and considering **adopting a baby boy from foster care**. Supporting birth mothers matters to them.
- **Cousin Alex** (she) **adopted a baby girl from China in January 2023**. Her agency prioritised birth-mother support and sent updates about the birth mother.
- **Morning routine**: wakes at **7:30 am**, does a **10-minute meditation**, then a **30-minute gym workout**. Wants breakfasts under 30 min.
- **Smoothie plan**: chose **vanilla** protein, specifically **NOW Foods Whey Protein Isolate** (because it is affordable and high in protein). Planned to make **Banana-Berry-Mango Bliss** "this weekend" (≈ Mar 18–19, 2023) and asked about almond milk brands.
- **Getting back into reading** after attending a **lecture on AI in healthcare**. Most interested in **deep learning in medical imaging** (segmentation/detection). Also curious about AI in research, leadership and education.
- Working on communication skills. Attended a **workshop on effective communication "at the beginning of last month"**, i.e. **early February 2023**.
- Sits on a **401k committee at work**. **Steve** offered to nominate the user as next **chairperson**. The user wants to **decline** and asked for a short email "in the style of Stephen King".
- **Gifts**: a graduation gift for their **best friend**, budget **$75–$100**, leaning toward a customizable photo album or personalized jewelry. **Coworker** thank-you gifts at **$10–$20**: they chose **funny mugs** and will check **Zazzle and Redbubble**, possibly also phone cases and laptop stickers.
- Asked Indian-law exam-style questions (Evidence Act, IT Act, digital signatures, UDRP, software piracy) and said to "answer all the questions based on indian laws". Probably a law student. Typing is terse with typos.
- Asked about Métis organizations for economic hardship and said "I will definitely reach out", so the user may be Métis or helping someone who is [assumed].
- Preparing a **debate on women in politics/leadership** (pro-women side).

| I assumed | User corrected / signalled | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Traditional princess theme | Wants unique, non-traditional | Offer non-stereotyped options for Olivia | "a bit more unique and not so traditional" |
| Generic answers on law topics | Wants an Indian-law frame | Cite Indian statutes (Evidence Act 1872 ss. 62–65, 65A/65B; IT Act 2000; Copyright Act 1957) | "answer all the questions based on indian laws" |
| Plain business email | Wanted a **Stephen King voice**, short | My draft had no King style at all. Redo with ominous, conversational King flavour, keep it short | "fairly short and write it in the style of Stephen King" |
| — | Wants debate-ready, punchy material | Write rebuttal lines, not encyclopedia entries | "make this part of rebuttal in debatae" |

## 6 · Evidence ledger (errors in my earlier answers; fix if revisited)
| Claim I made | Status | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| "Angela Merkel **has been** Chancellor since 2005" | stale | She served 2005–Dec 2021 |
| Indira Gandhi served "1966 until her assassination in 1984" | wrong | She served 1966–77 and 1980–84 |
| "Hearsay… photocopies" given as Indian secondary evidence; "I don't have knowledge after 2021" | sloppy | Secondary evidence is defined in s.63 and its admissibility in s.65 of the Evidence Act; electronic records fall under s.65B (Anvar P.V. 2014, Arjun Panditrao 2020) |
| UDRP: "no appeal" | misleading | Either party can go to court; the registrar waits 10 business days before implementing a transfer |
| AI books "AI Medicine" (Topol & Verghese), "The AI Doctor" (Klasko), "Healthcare Reboot" (Hoque) | likely fabricated | Only *Deep Medicine* (Topol, 2019) is solid. Litjens et al. 2017 is a real imaging survey. The other paper titles/authors are unverified |
| "DeepMind Health" breast-cancer detection | imprecise | It was Google Health/DeepMind (McKinney et al., Nature 2020) |
| Leadership tool "Haleo" | likely fabricated | Drop it |
| Adoption agencies "Adoption Connection, Nightlight, Family Builders" | unverified | Tell the user to check CDSS licensing. Foster adoption in CA is usually through county agencies or FFAs and is often low or no cost |
| Métis orgs ("Métis Nation Financial Wellness Program" etc.) | unverified, possibly generic names | Point to real bodies: Métis Nation of Ontario, Métis Nation–Saskatchewan, Métis Nation of Alberta, Manitoba Métis Federation, plus the provincial 211 line |
| Overnight oats "cook time 10 min" | wrong | No cooking needed |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Olivia party (Art Studio)**: Paint station (sponge-stamp abstract art), Marker station (rainbow drawing), Glue station (magazine/fabric collage), Paper station (folding and sculpture). Displays: mini gallery with a "critic's corner" (berets, fake mustaches), clothesline "art walk", collaborative mural, take-home art book. Also smocks/aprons. Next steps offered: invitations, games, favors, layout, menu (the user didn't pick one).
- **Twins themes offered**: Woodland Wonderland, Carnival, Little Explorer, Sweet Treat, Vintage Circus. Favors offered: teething toys/soft blocks (Little Explorer), seed bombs/small plants (Woodland).
- **CA home study**: I said it takes **3–6 months** and costs **$1,500–$3,000**. Note that county foster-adoption home studies (RFA) are typically free, so correct this if asked.
- **Protein**: ON Gold Standard ($25–30/lb), MusclePharm Combat, BSN Syntha-6, NOW Whey Isolate ($15–20/lb, I said "20g protein per 28g scoop"), Amazon Elements. **Almond milk**: Almond Breeze, Silk, Blue Diamond, Califia, Great Value. Also fruit pairings and the recipes "Peachy Keen" and "Kiwi Kraze".
- **Mug sites**: Zazzle, Redbubble, CafePress, TeeFury, The Oatmeal, "MugLife" (unverified), Threadless, Society6. I also gave a list of mug quotes, e.g. "Coffee: because adulting is hard".
- **Graduation gift stores**: Etsy, Amazon, Personalization Mall, Things Remembered, Zales, James Avery; Shutterfly, Snapfish, Mixbook, Blurb, Picaboo, Artifact Uprising.
- **Steve email**: a polite but plain decline. It wrongly lectured Steve about ESRI and invented FINRA experience (see §4).
- **Women in leadership examples**: Cleopatra, Wu Zetian, Elizabeth I, Indira Gandhi, Merkel.

## 9 · Gotchas
- Session timestamps in the transcript are out of chronological order. All threads are on the same day, 2023-03-17.
- In the adoption thread the user once pasted an assistant-style reply by mistake and then apologised ("I was supposed to respond as a user"). Nothing to act on.
